During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Seth Cambriel]] owned a [[WBY-102 FirstMate]] '''droid''' that he used to help crew his [[Yacht (aquatic)/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Cambus Gale]]''. He had disabled the ability to transmit a distress signal in the standard [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] built into the droid, and gave it regularly [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] so that it did not retain a personality. When a group of Rebel agents were sent to Cambriel's aid on [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] to smuggle vital supplies off-planet, Cambriel taught the agents to sail his vessel through the use of his droid.
